home.title: Code. Systems. Graphics.
home.intro: I’m Ali Raza, a developer and graphic designer based in Bolton, UK. I recently graduated from The Sixth Form Bolton, where I studied Computer Science, Graphics and ICT, and I now focus on building independent software and creative technology projects. My work spans AI systems, full-stack web development, Linux, automation and visual design. I enjoy taking complex ideas, understanding how they work from the inside out, and turning them into useful, distinctive experiences.
about: I’m most at home where technical problem-solving and visual thinking overlap. I like understanding systems from the inside out, finding the awkward parts, then designing better ways to solve them. Whether I’m building a local AI assistant, a personal operating system, a web application or a visual identity, I care about how the pieces work together rather than simply making something that works once.

My practice is self-directed and hands-on. I’ve built and deployed projects using Python, Flask, SQLite, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, while exploring technologies including LLMs, local AI, browser automation, vector databases, Linux desktop control and text-to-speech. Alongside software, my background in graphics gives me a strong interest in visual communication, interface design and making technical products feel intentional.

I’m particularly interested in building tools that give people more control over their technology. Projects such as CIEL, my local-first AI assistant, and LifeOS, my personal productivity and life-management platform, reflect that approach: understand the problem, build the system, test it in the real world, then keep improving it.
I speak English and Spanish fluently, with Urdu as my native language.

projects.title: CIEL
projects.subtitle: Central Intelligence & Execution Layer
projects.summary: CIEL is a local-first AI assistant and execution layer designed to move beyond chat. It brings conversational AI together with persistent memory, browser automation, desktop control and autonomous workflows, so an assistant can understand a request and meaningfully act on it within a real computer environment.
details: The system combines voice input and output, Playwright browser automation, desktop control and a modular tool architecture that can connect to external services without losing the context of the user’s wider workflow.
Built around Arch Linux, CIEL explores what a practical, highly integrated personal assistant can look like when local tools, memory and user control are treated as first-class parts of the product.

projects.title: LifeOS
projects.subtitle: Personal operating system
projects.summary: LifeOS is a full-stack personal management platform that gathers tasks, habits, goals, projects and journaling in one place. It was built around a simple question: what would a personal system feel like if it reflected how someone actually plans, thinks and changes direction?
details: The Python and Flask backend is backed by a relational database, with features developed iteratively and restructured when the original architecture stopped serving the product.
It also exposes an API layer, allowing other applications such as CIEL to read and write useful information rather than remaining isolated tools.

projects.title: ADML
projects.subtitle: AutoDesign Markup Language
projects.summary: A markup language exploring a more controllable route from AI instructions to polished visual design.
details: A custom syntax, parser and compiler pipeline.
An experiment in turning creative intent into predictable output.

projects.title: PCP
projects.subtitle: Portable Compute Protocol
projects.summary: An Arch-based portable computing environment designed to run primarily from RAM.
details: Exploring boot infrastructure, image generation and portability.
A hands-on way to understand the stack from firmware to operating system.

experience.summary: Designed and built an e-commerce website against real client requirements, from the initial structure and visual interface through to implementation and refinement.
details: Planned the site structure and designed the interface in Figma.
Built and refined the website using HTML5 and CSS3.

experience.summary: Founded and ran an experimental technology-focused e-commerce and dropshipping business, taking ownership across the product and its operations.
details: Led the website, design and brand identity.
Managed technical infrastructure and process automation.

journey: Completed 8 GCSEs at grade 4 or above, including Computer Science, Graphics, Mathematics, Science, English Language and English Literature.
Started A Level Computer Science, A Level Graphics and a BTEC Certificate in ICT — intentionally combining technical foundations with visual communication.
Developed LifeOS, CIEL, ADML and PCP: a set of projects spanning full-stack applications, local AI, automation, structured design generation and Linux infrastructure.
Continuing to deepen my software engineering and graphic design practice through independent work, experimentation and client-ready projects.
